      Horsepower is between 100 and 150. 103 values. Avg Horsepower: 118.
      Horsepower is between 150 and 230. 71 values. Avg Horsepower: 172.

      Cylinders equals 3. 4 values. Avg Horsepower: 99.
      Cylinders equals 4. 202 values. Avg Horsepower: 78.
      Cylinders equals 5. 3 values. Avg Horsepower: 82.
      Cylinders equals 6. 83 values. Avg Horsepower: 102.
      Cylinders equals 8. 108 values. Avg Horsepower: 158.
